column1: # Book 6 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 6.800 plenior describes the bather; "too full" after "hot baths" read as the baths.
# 6.830-832 interdum: "at times" on the result carries the same sense; decision, no change.
# 6.850-851 partim goes with homines: some suppose; the English had made it an adverb on fervescere.
